title: List of non-OECD countries that are authorized to import certain non-hazardous waste from the EU

triage.reason: Commission delegated regulation under the Waste Shipment Regulation listing non-OECD countries authorised to import EU non-hazardous waste (relevant to plastic waste exports) went through a public feedback window that closed on 16 October 2026, a concrete implementing step for the export ban from 21 May 2027.

draft.summary: The feedback period on the draft regulation listing the non-OECD countries authorised to import certain non-hazardous waste from the EU closed on 16 October 2026. The regulation relates to the ban on exporting non-hazardous waste to non-OECD countries from 21 May 2027.
draft.source_quote: frontEndStage: ISC_WORKFLOW; receivingFeedbackStatus: CLOSED; feedbackStartDate: 2026/09/18 11:38:36; feedbackEndDate: 2026/10/16 23:59:59

key_dates.text: Ban on the export of non-hazardous waste from the EU to non-OECD countries takes effect; the listed countries are those authorised to continue receiving such waste.

draft.interpretation: Exporters of non-hazardous waste will need to confirm that their destination appears on the delegated list before shipping after 21 May 2027, as unlisted non-OECD destinations would no longer be available for such exports.
